meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.

howto.what: 把指定的 agent group 从 Anthropic API 切到本机 Ollama 模型上跑:改写 container.json 的环境变量、在共享设置里填模型名,再重建并重启服务,最后用 curl、docker 命令核对是否生效。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 在本机运行、想省 API 费用,或想试用开放权重模型时触发;前提是 Ollama 已装好并在运行、模型已 pull、agent group 已存在。

say.text: 在 container.json 里把 api.anthropic.com 挡掉
帮我把这个 agent 换回 Anthropic API

howto.what_en: Routes a chosen agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: it sets the container.json env vars, writes the model name into the shared settings file, rebuilds and restarts the service, then checks the result with curl and docker commands.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running, the model already pulled, and the agent group already created.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group over to a local Ollama model

say_en.text: Switch this agent back to the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts
